lyrics:
[Intro: pulsing synth bass, dry drum machine]

[Verse 1: breathy female voice, close]
Light comes on
In the hall
I didn't move
I didn't move at all

[Chorus: voice doubled, cold pad]
Motion, motion
Sensor
Something moved
Motion

[Verse 2: whispering, hi-hat ticking]
Stand so still
Count to ten
It goes dark
I move again

[Chorus: voice doubled, cold pad]
Motion, motion
Sensor
Something moved
Motion

[Instrumental: detuned lead line over the bass]

[Bridge: bass only, gasped]
See me. See me.
Is it you? See me.

[Final Chorus: fuller, a second voice far back]
Motion, motion
Sensor
Something moved
Motion

[Outro: bass stops, a relay clicks, dark]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 118 BPM, 4/4, F minor. Minimal, pulsing and tense, built from very few parts.

VOICE: Female, low and breathy, whispered and half-gasped with long pauses, very close to the microphone. Doubled in the choruses. A second voice echoes from far away near the end.

INSTRUMENTS: A pulsing sixteenth-note analogue synth bass, a dry vintage drum machine with a snappy snare, a ticking hi-hat, one cold pad chord, a thin detuned lead line, a click of a relay at the end.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, bass and drums. 0:20 Verse 1. 0:44 Chorus 1. 1:04 Verse 2. 1:28 Chorus 2. 1:48 Instrumental. 2:12 Bridge, gasped. 2:32 Final chorus. 2:58 Outro, bass stops, a click at 3:24.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Minimal wave and dark electro: dry, mono-ish and stark, analogue gear with no decoration, voice breathing in the listener's ear.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'I didn't move. I didn't move at all.' at 0:32.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original repeats a word for what a person feels. This house reacts to movement by itself, and the woman in it is no longer sure whether she is alone or only undetected.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Startled, still, wanting, dark.
